text:
Aisha Khan: Quick heads-up — Meridian QBR walkthrough scheduled Thu 10:00am PT. I put together an updated runbook and a short risk matrix. Need: slide owners, any onboarding blockers to call out, and final asks for execs.
Diego Morales: Ack. I'm happy to take the 'Performance & Cost' slide. I'll add a short note on recent latency improvements and current tail latency numbers.
Sophie Lee: @Diego can you add the post-rollout batch/quantization savings as a single stat? Execs like one-liners. I'll own the customer health slide and top 3 onboarding blockers.
Ravi Patel: FYI renewal signal: usage dropped 18% over last 2 weeks on two heavy routes. I flagged to CS playbook as "at-risk - product". We should include a mitigation ask: change routing to dedicated capacity + a 2-week pilot.
Aisha Khan: Good catch, @Ravi. Can you paste the two routes and affected teams here? Also add the customer impact line for the slide: e.g., "18% request drop; 9% reduction in conversion on search flow."
Ravi Patel: Routes: /v1/generate (search flow), /v1/embeddings (recommendations). Impact: search conversion -9%, support tickets up 2.
Jordan (AM): I'll prep the exec ask: short summary, proposed pilot (2 weeks, Dedicated burst), expected ROI calc (cost vs lost revenue). Need the baseline revenue delta by EOD so I can draft the slide.
Marta (RevOps): I can run a quick ARR exposure calc — give me the daily request delta. Also recommend we include an SLA/escalation path in the appendix: contact matrix, SLA target, and temporary credits if pilot accepted.
Sophie Lee: On onboarding blockers: 1) missing sample prompts for recommendation tuning, 2) partial telemetry on production that hides latency spikes, 3) unclear key rotation steps for private infra.
Aisha Khan: Perfect. Action items: 1) Diego — add cost/latency one-liner + stat (by today EOD). 2) Sophie — customer health slide + onboarding bullets (by tomorrow noon). 3) Ravi — short route list + mitigation text (ASAP). 4) Jordan — draft exec ask + ROI (by EOD). 5) Marta — ARR exposure + SLA appendix content (by tomorrow). 6) Aisha — assemble slides and run dry-run Wed 9am PT.
Diego Morales: Will do. I'll post the stat as: "Batching+quantization -> 32% per-token cost reduction; p99 latency improved 120ms" so it's crisp.
Ravi Patel: Adding quick note: recommend temporary throttling on low-priority recommendation calls during pilot to protect search flow.
Marta (RevOps): Noted on throttling — I'll include estimated revenue impact for both throttling and pilot.
Aisha Khan: Also: @notifier-bot please pin the slides doc and the runbook in this thread when ready.
notifier-bot: Document pinned: https://redwood.docs/meridian-qbr/runbook-v2 (auto)
Sophie Lee: Minor ask — can design produce a single-slide visual for the risk matrix (green/orange/red) by Wed morning? If not, I can do a simplified table.
Jordan (AM): I'll check design. If they can't, simplified table is fine. Execs prefer clarity > fancy. :thumbsup:
Aisha Khan: Thanks team — I'll follow up with calendar invites for the dry-run and final slide deck location. If anyone hits blockers on their items, drop them here and we'll reassign. :white_check_mark:
